text:
jen-ops: Heads-up — planning a small cutover of the 'dedicated-gpu-eu' pool tonight 19:30 UTC. This changes the autoscaler minBurst from 2 -> 4 and adjusts the slice eviction threshold.
samir: Thanks — what's the exact rollback plan if we see increased latency or failed allocations? :thinking:
jen-ops: Rollback plan is quick: revert the autoscale params and scale down new slices. If any allocation errors appear, we'll abort and roll back to previous pool config via the config-store. Timeline: 19:30 start, 10m canary, 30m watch, then full ramp if green.
leo: pinging infra on-call to be nearby. @diane can you run the smoke test checklist once canary is live? :ok_hand:
diane: yep, I'll do the smoke run. Which canary selector are we using? pod label or tenant tag?
aj: Canary will be 5% traffic routed to pool variant 'slice-v2-canary' — routing controlled by route-table version v12. CLI to flip is below.
aj: ```
# flip canary (deploy-bot will do actual call)
redwoodctl routes set --route inference-text --version v12 --canary 0.05
``` 
deploy-bot: deploy request received: pr https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/inference/+/PR-5423 changes autoscaler config for pool dedicated-gpu-eu
samir: what signals are we watching? latency P50/P95, schedule failures, GPU OOMs, and evictions?
jen-ops: correct — primary signals: P95 latency increase >10% over baseline, schedule_failure_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m, and new slice evictions > 1/min. Also watch token throughput per GPU.
leo: I'll keep an eye on node alloc logs. command to tail scheduler logs:
leo: ```
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=scheduler -f --since=10m
```
diane: smoke checklist I'll run after canary: 1) simple generate 5x with long prompt (seq 2k), 2) start 10 parallel short requests, 3) embedding throughput sanity, 4) verify no evictions in last 5m. I'll paste results.
samir: tagging QA: @maria-qa — if you can run the regression prompt set once I post the canary endpoint that'd be great.
maria-qa: available. send endpoint and creds and I'll run the eval set.
jen-ops: canary endpoint will be inference.canary.eu.redwood.internal + same auth token. We'll post the exact time when flip happens (ETA 19:30 UTC). Expect brief errors during route switch (~15s) — nothing to panic about.
aj: also note we'll enable metric-level debug for autoscaler for the first 15m: autoscaler.log_level=debug. Remember to turn it back down if noise is high.
leo: If we need immediate rollback I can trigger deploy-bot to execute the revert script:
leo: ```
deploy-bot revert --config-store pool/dedicated-gpu-eu --to-rev 2026-03-15T22:00:00Z
```
diane: I'll post smoke results in thread. If I see >1 eviction or P95 spike >12% I'll call rollback.
jen-ops: cool. ownership: jen-ops (lead), samir (SLO owner), leo (infra ops), diane (smoke/QA), aj (routing config). On-call: infra oncall (linked in PagerDuty).
deploy-bot: ACTION: scheduled at 2890012600 for route flip; will announce when executed.
k8s-bot: Event: new slice template applied to pool dedicated-gpu-eu-canary at 19:30 UTC
maria-qa: ready — will post regression results within 12 min of endpoint go-live.
samir: quick CR ping: PR-5423 still needs one more review for the eviction backoff math. @jen-ops can you confirm you signed off on the backoff default change?
jen-ops: signed off on backoff default = 30s -> 60s for aggressive slicing. CI green.
leo: all set here. I'll be in the #oncall voice room during the window.
diane: canary flip done — posting smoke: long prompt OK, 10 parallel ok, but saw 1 transient allocation failure at t+3m (retriable) — no evictions. P95 +4%.
samir: +4% P95 is within tolerance. Maria — how did regression go?
maria-qa: regression set pass rate 98/100, two failures were timeouts that retried successfully. Looks safe to ramp.
jen-ops: ramping to 30% at 19:45 UTC now.
deploy-bot: flip completed to 30% — monitoring.
leo: no new OOMs, scheduler error rate normal.
diane: continued smoke OK, will continue 30m watch then full ramp.
jen-ops: thanks everyone. If anything breaks use the revert command above. I'll update post-mortem notes in the release doc tomorrow.
samir: nice and smooth — record the config change in the capacity audit: CL/PR-5423.
jen-ops: closing out here — final note: remember to reset autoscaler.log_level back to info at 20:10 UTC if all green.
